body:
Three additions to adding a project, in 84d9191 and running in the existing HTTPS app, on the owner's later 2026-10-07 direction. The Add project dialog shows the place the folder goes to, and Zmień miejsce… opens a chooser inside the application: enter folders below the approved directories, add one with Nowy folder, confirm with Wybierz ten folder. Publishing to GitHub is now a setting, Ustawienia → Publikuj nowe projekty na GitHubie; it is on by default and was set on explicitly for the Owner profile. With it off a project stays local, without Git, until it is published from its Git dialog. projectctl project create runs the same folder, registration and publication steps, and the in-app agent is instructed to create projects only through it, in the default place without asking.

The 16-step gate passes with 490 Rust and 529 Node tests. The smoke and 41 of 42 Chromium suites passed in one run; command-recovery failed on a test fixture without an approved directory and passes after that fixture was corrected. The project-creation suite now has nine scenarios, including the chooser, the switch and the CLI command. Not exercised: the agent creating a project through a real Claude Code or Codex run, and creating a repository on GitHub itself, because either would make a real folder and repository on the owner's account. Evidence: progress/2026-10-07-project-places.md.

metadata.summary: Project place chooser, GitHub publication setting and CLI/agent project creation
